source: Characteristics of the unified e-visa and conditions for its issuance at https://evisa.kdmid.ru/Home/Instruction, plus the information portal pages https://electronic-visa.kdmid.ru/index_en.html, /country_en.html, /checkpoint_en.html, /faq_en.html and /support_en.html, read 2026-08-30. The application itself sits behind a personal-account login at https://evisa.kdmid.ru/, so no field regexes, character limits or official validation error strings could be read; no pattern key is used and no local validator is mounted.

eligibility.label: E-visa nationality eligibility
eligibility.help: The ministry lists 64 foreign states whose nationals can apply for the unified e-visa. A passport outside that list needs a regular visa from a Russian diplomatic mission or consular post.

entry_purpose.label: Purpose of travel
entry_purpose.placeholder: Private or business visit, tourism, or an event
entry_purpose.help: The e-visa covers a private or business visit, tourism, and participation in scientific, cultural, socio-political, economic or sporting events. There is no transit option in the application; other purposes need a regular visa.

errors.required: Select a purpose the e-visa covers

children.label: Children travelling with you
children.help: Children registered in a parent's passport still need their own e-visa. Applicants under 6 years of age on the date of submission pay no consular fee.

errors.required: Confirm the number of separate applications

insurance.label: Medical insurance valid in Russia
insurance.help: Travellers on a unified e-visa must hold medical insurance valid in Russia for the entire stay. Some nationalities are exempt on the basis of reciprocity; the application asks about it, and missing insurance data alone is not a reason for refusal.

payment.label: Consular fee payment
payment.help: The amount appears at the payment step. Invoices are issued in dirhams or yuan, Russian bank cards are not accepted, confirmation takes 20 to 45 minutes, and the fee is not refunded whatever the outcome.

errors.required: Confirm the payment rules before applying

email.label: Email address for notifications
email.help: Notifications about progress and results go to this address and to your personal account. The portal asks applicants to avoid Gmail because delivery has been unstable and delayed.

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.placeholder: As printed in the machine-readable zone
passport_number.help: The passport must be machine-readable. If the form rejects your passport number, the official advice is to write to evisa_info@kdmid.ru with a photo of the passport attached; the ministry does not publish the rule the field applies.

passport_scan.label: Photo of the passport data page
passport_scan.help: The ministry asks for a digital photo of your passport data in JPEG format, taken from the passport you will use to cross the border.

errors.required: A passport data page image is required

face_photo.label: Digital face photo
face_photo.help: Taken within 6 months, full face, neutral expression, plain light background, no shadows. The photo must be rectangular with a 35x45 aspect ratio and the face must take up 70-80 percent of it.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity and stamp space
passport_validity.placeholder: At least 6 months from the date you apply
passport_validity.help: The passport must be issued by your country of nationality, machine-readable, valid for at least 6 months from the date the application is submitted, and have sufficient space for border crossing stamps.

errors.required: Confirm passport validity and stamp space

entry_date.label: Intended date of entry
entry_date.help: The application can be submitted no earlier than 86 days and no later than 4 days before the expected entry date. The site's own calculator asks for the date in DD.MM.YYYY format.

errors.required: Intended date of entry is required

stay_length.label: Length of stay
stay_length.help: The stay may not exceed 30 days from the date of entry, and the exit date cannot be later than 120 days after issue. The ministry warns that the day of arrival and the day of departure both count, so 30 days is not 720 hours of net time.

errors.required: Confirm the stay fits the 30-day limit

exit_checkpoint.label: Entry and exit crossing points
exit_checkpoint.help: The e-visa is valid for entry and for exit only through the border crossing points approved by the government. The published list is grouped into air, road, rail, sea and pedestrian points.

errors.required: Check both crossing points against the list
